prompt: Match each tool or command to what it does when installing and administering Redis Software.
explanation: `rladmin cluster create` bootstraps the first node of a new cluster, while `rladmin cluster join` adds a newly installed node to a cluster that already exists. `rlcheck` is the health verification utility that must pass on every node before an upgrade, `rladmin node maintenance_mode on` drains a node for OS patching by migrating its shards elsewhere, and `rladmin node 3 remove` permanently retires a node and frees its capacity.

pairs.right: Bootstrap the first node of a new cluster
Add a new node to an existing cluster
Run per-node verification tests before an upgrade
Drain shards off a node before OS patching
Permanently remove a node from the cluster
